connector.registryDescription: VK (VKontakte): read walls, users, communities and stats; publish, edit and comment on posts.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package vk-mcp-server. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the bulatko account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: VK_ACCESS_TOKEN
env.description: VK API access token. Quickest route if you manage a community: Manage -> API usage -> Access tokens -> Create token, ticking wall and photos — no app needed, and it is tied to neither a browser nor an IP. To act as yourself, create your own Standalone app at https://vk.com/editapp?act=create and run `npx vk-mcp-server --login <APP_ID>`. Use your own app rather than a shared ID: a token dies with the app that issued it. Full guide: https://github.com/bulatko/vk-mcp-server/blob/master/docs/SETUP.md
